selection_rationale: Best-aligned with the track’s reliability/verification focus (generate–verify–repair for multi-vendor CLI), high venue relevance and feasibility, falsifiable primary outcome (verifier pass-rate), and reviewer verdict = pass; required design repairs are concrete and tractable before preregistration.
unresolved_uncertainties: UQ1: Minimal verifier/contract needed to grant autonomous authority in production remains unsettled (operational thresholds and rollback guarantees).
UQ2: Governance and measurement of prompt uncertainty/admissible prompt families for fair NetOps evaluation are immature.
UQ3: Standardized benchmark metrics that fully capture operational correctness, safety, and rollback-readiness are not yet established.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify exact deterministic verifier implementation and version (e.g., Batfish vX.Y) and enumerate the modeled properties (reachability, ACL semantics, VLAN behavior) to be checked.
Provide documented justification and validation evidence for simulator/emulator fidelity (what control-plane/stateful behaviors are modeled and which are out-of-scope).
Specify exact LLM model identifier(s) and provider, temperature/logprob/seed policies, token limits, prompt templates (primary and any few-shot/context), and total model-call budget.
Provide the exact conversion mapping from verifier outputs (error traces, counterexamples) to localized repair prompts (templated transformation rules) with examples.

Add a sample-size/power calculation justifying n=120 for the primary outcome (expected baseline pass rate, minimal detectable absolute difference, alpha, power) and prespecify handling of excluded tasks.
Predefine a verifier-failure taxonomy with objective thresholds that separate syntactic, semantic, and topological errors and spell out automated labeling rules.

Specify multi-vendor translation tooling (parsers/normalizers), versions, and instrumentation to attribute errors to translation vs LLM reasoning; prespecify exclusion/attribution rules for translation-induced failures.

Prespecify inclusion/exclusion criteria for task selection and a deterministic task-sampling procedure (random seeds, dataset splits) so preregistration freezes dataset and avoids post-hoc task selection.
